name: Interagency Coordination and Construction Permits Data (MOSYS)
description:
This dataset tracks capital construction projects that affect New York City parks, recording the interagency coordination and permitting process from initial project intake through construction and final acceptance. Each row represents a project, with fields covering the project name, description, sponsoring agency (such as CDOT, PANYNJ, or USGS), primary scope of work, contract value, current phase, and whether the project is single-site, multi-site, or multi-borough. It also identifies impacted parks by ID and name, along with borough, address or intersection, park division, and impact type (for example staging, excavation, or partial park closure).

A large share of the columns capture dates and milestones across the project lifecycle: project receipt, scoping kickoff, design commission approvals, design completion, construction kickoff and expected or actual end dates, permit request and issuance, permit start and expiration, extensions and amendments, substantial completion, inspections, punchlist generation, conditional letters, and final acceptance.
